name: toolbar
responsibility: Provides toolbar role, orientation, focus, and keyboard interaction only; generates neither appearance nor content.

authorMarkup.root: An HTMLElement with data-controller="toolbar"; the consumer supplies its accessible name through aria-label or aria-labelledby.
authorMarkup.control: An HTMLElement inside the root with data-toolbar-target="control", such as a button, link, input, or menu button
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate elements or content.
authorMarkup.nestedComposite: Coordination with nested composite widgets is outside scope; composite widgets manage their own keyboard interaction.

controls: At least one control target is required.
Control targets must be root descendants.
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: With no control targets, warn once per connection and disable role, ARIA, listeners, and tabindex operations. Do not throw.
contractValidation.warning: Warnings identify toolbar controller and the requirement for control targets.
contractValidation.completionExempt: aria-orientation reflects the orientation configuration and is not subject to completion warnings.

activeControl.description: The current roving-tabindex Tab stop, or undefined when no enabled control is available.

focusFirst().description: Focus the first enabled control, or do nothing if none exists.

focusLast().description: Focus the last enabled control, or do nothing if none exists.

events.none: Toolbar emits no custom events. Consumers and nested widgets manage their controls' own events.

keyboard.focusModel: Exactly one enabled control has tabindex="0"; others have tabindex="-1". Tab enters at that control. Exclude disabled controls from both the Tab stop and navigation.

horizontalLtr.ArrowLeft: Move to the previous enabled control.
horizontalLtr.ArrowRight: Move to the next enabled control.

horizontalRtl.ArrowLeft: Move to the next enabled control.
horizontalRtl.ArrowRight: Move to the previous enabled control.
horizontalRtl.directionSource: Use the toolbar root's computed direction, including inherited direction.

vertical.ArrowUp: Move to the previous enabled control.
vertical.ArrowDown: Move to the next enabled control.

common.Home: Move to the first enabled control.
common.End: Move to the last enabled control.
common.wrap: Previous/next navigation wraps at both ends.

keyboard.selection: Toolbar has no selection state or events; moving focus does not change a control's selection.

root: Supply aria-orientation="vertical" only when orientation=vertical and the attribute is absent.
control: Give one enabled control tabindex="0" and set the others to "-1".
managedMarkup.disabled: Prefer the native disabled property on controls that have one; otherwise treat aria-disabled="true" as disabled. Do not add disabled data-* attributes.
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve authored role, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-orientation, and other attributes. Synchronize tabindex as controller-owned focus state.

stateOutputs.none: Do not output data-state on toolbar roots or controls; toolbar has no component state.

lifecycle: Register event subscriptions and MutationObserver in connect(), and remove them in disconnect(). Do not duplicate them during Turbo reconnection.
Leave generated role, aria-orientation, and tabindex on disconnect().
Track native disabled, aria-disabled, and orientation changes.

observations.item: Toolbar name, orientation, and roving-focus announcements
observations.impact: The Toolbar pattern and native control semantics are fixed independently of announcement wording.

acceptanceCriteria: Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
For conforming markup, controller role, orientation, focus, and keyboard interaction must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA. Consumers determine accessible names, control meaning, focus indicators, and layout.
Role, name, orientation, focus, and keyboard interaction must match the WAI-ARIA APG Toolbar Pattern.
Whenever enabled controls exist, exactly one is a Tab stop; exclude disabled controls.
Home, End, wrapping, horizontal LTR/RTL, and vertical keyboard behavior agree across all three engines.
Dynamic targets, disabled changes, and disconnect/reconnect do not duplicate listeners or MutationObserver.
Invalid markup disables enhancement with one warning
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Report real-device screen reader verification as unverified.

testMatrix.description: Role, orientation, tabindex, authored attributes, and absence of data-state

Warnings and disabled enhancement for unsupported orientation
